transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this pre-job review together because we need to discuss the solvent-recovery trial before any authorization is made. Before I can authorize this trial, plant policy requires me to conduct this review with process engineering, maintenance, and environmental compliance. I'd like to go through each element of the standard pre-job procedure: equipment inspection, closed transfer, ventilation verification, vapor monitoring, and documented waste handling. Let's start with process engineering -- can you walk us through the current status of the equipment inspection and whether the skid is ready for a production solvent trial?
